I know a lot of people are going to hate me for doing this, but I have to expose this. There is a group of people, apparently led by GameDiviner and QuQu who are actively working to destroy GamerGate. If they want to quit GamerGate, that's perfectly fine, but they plan on taking everyone else along with them and killing everything that we have spent the past year fighting for.

That's not to say that GamerGate is perfect, because it isn't. QuQu and GameDiviner have valid complaints about the current state of GamerGate and KotakuInAction, but killing GamerGate isn't the way to move forward. I propose that we work together and reform the problems from within. To do that we're going to need less infighting and more interest in getting work done. Whether that's digging for information, sharing information or simply getting the word out there. Everyone can contribute in their own unique way.

Under normal circumstances I would never leak private messages, but these aren't normal circumstances. I'm not saying the people involved are inherently bad people either, only that they are misguided. At first I tried talking them out of it, but once it became apparent that they had made up their mind, I had to pretend to support their cause in order to extract more information from them, which is regrettable. I actually like some of the people involved, but at the end of the day, I must do what I feel is right and so I must blow the whistle on this.

Myself and others have formed a coalition of our own that is opposed to killing GamerGate. Please stand with us and together we can save GamerGate and work towards a better and brighter future!
